# pr-size-guard

> Measure pull request size from git numstat or unified diffs, ignore lock and generated files, flag warn and fail thresholds, and suggest directory-based slices. Import name `pr_size_guard`; Python >= 3.10; no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example, public API, limits, errors, CLI

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the test module and what it covers
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): package shape and public API
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): standard-library modules used
